new_evidence_ids.rationale: New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each declared member name resolves to its canonical enum member.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: A non-string integer is not an accepted enum wire value.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each of six identifier fields accepts ordinary, length-one, and length-128 text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each identifier field rejects the empty built-in string.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each identifier must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric character.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each identifier field rejects Unicode surrogate code points.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each identifier field rejects non-NFC text independently of portable grammar.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each identifier field rejects length 129 above the inclusive maximum 128.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version accepts ordinary, length-one, and length-64 portable text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version requires exact built-in str and performs no coercion.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version rejects empty text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric character.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version rejects characters outside its portable continuation set.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version rejects Unicode surrogate code points.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version rejects non-NFC text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Observed version rejects length 65 above the inclusive maximum 64.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: A present digest cannot be the empty string.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: A present digest must be exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: A present digest rejects Unicode surrogate code points.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: A present digest rejects decomposed non-NFC text before SHA grammar admission.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Optional digest presence participates symmetrically in exact equality.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: InstallationObservation is unequal to an unrelated object.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every identifier field accepts ordinary, length-one, and length-128 text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every identifier field rejects empty built-in string text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every identifier field rejects an embedded ASCII space.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every identifier must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric character.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every identifier field rejects Unicode surrogate code points.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every identifier field rejects non-NFC text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every identifier field rejects length 129 above the inclusive maximum 128.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Status accepts each of the three exact VerificationStatus members.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Status rejects a non-enum, non-string semantic type.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every evidence tuple member requires exact built-in str.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every evidence tuple member must be nonempty.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every evidence tuple member must satisfy portable identifier grammar.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every evidence tuple member begins with an ASCII alphanumeric character.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every evidence tuple member rejects Unicode surrogate code points.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every evidence tuple member rejects non-NFC text.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Every evidence tuple member rejects length 129 above maximum 128.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Multiple evidence identifiers must be in ascending lexical order.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Evidence identifier tuples must contain unique members.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Each distinct status member produces a distinct verification state.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: Distinct valid evidence tuples produce distinct verification states.
New independent evidence owner required to verify: VerificationObservation is unequal to an unrelated object.
